# A conclusion with nothing behind it

`Tool: tol-conclusion-no-reason` `APPROVED`

## What we use it for

Rendering invoices. The package declares one licence, this entry concludes another, and no
`## Licence and obligations` section sits between them. That is what `conclusion-states-a-reason` reports: nobody
reading this can tell whether the conclusion came from the licence files or from a guess.
